title: Counter-Replacement Price Rule for Discounted Tire Tickets
content:
**Counter-replacement price.** For a replacement a Crestline store carried out at its counter and posted to a Road Hazard Protection certificate, the price the coverage percentage is applied to depends on how the covered set's original Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty ticket was paid and discounted:

1. when the covered set's ticket was charged to a Crestline Fleet Account and the fleet invoice posted for the vehicle on the set's purchase date with service category tires shows a program discount, the counter-replacement price is the unit price less that discount divided by the ticket's tire count (the whole tires-invoice discount, mounting and kits included, spread over the ticket's tires), rounded half up to the cent;
2. when the ticket was not charged to a fleet account and carried at least the line's set-instant-savings minimum number of tires of a line whose set instant savings is above zero, it is the unit price less the set instant savings divided by the tire count, rounded half up to the cent;
3. otherwise it is the covered set's unit price.

| Ticket tender | Discount evidence | Price |
|---|---|---|
| fleet account | tires invoice on the purchase date shows a program discount | unit price less discount divided by tire count, rounded to the cent |
| fleet account | no program discount on that invoice | unit price |
| any other tender | tire count at least the line's minimum and line savings above zero | unit price less set instant savings divided by tire count, rounded to the cent |
| any other tender | fewer tires than the minimum, or no line savings | unit price |

*Hypothetical figures.* Unit price 160.00, four tires, fleet tires invoice discount 70.00: 160.00 less 17.50 is 142.50. Unit price 150.00, four tires, set instant savings 60.00 with a four-tire minimum: 150.00 less 15.00 is 135.00. Unit price 133.33 with a 10.00 set instant saving and a three-tire minimum, three tires on the ticket: 133.33 less 3.333 is 129.997, rounded to 130.00.
